english.text: The expanded working paper concluded that in order to increase efficiency in the fight against sexual violence and abuse, the process of gathering evidence when these crimes are involved should be reviewed, judicial systems should be harmonized and international judicial cooperation strengthened.

french.text: Elle a estimé dans sa conclusion que, pour accroître l'efficacité de la lutte contre les violences et les abus sexuels, il faudrait recenser et passer en revue les modes de preuve concernant ces crimes, harmoniser les systèmes judiciaires et renforcer la coopération judiciaire internationale.
